shared_elements: upright slab/pillar bearing carved figural imagery on its broad face
relief carving of a living creature in low relief
imagery confined to a single vertical panel
justification: Both are upright slabs carrying low-relief imagery of a living being on the broad face, but that is a generic correspondence: A shows an elaborately costumed frontal standing human with headdress, ornaments and dense filler detail covering the whole panel, while B shows a sparse, schematic quadruped animal in profile plus a smaller creature, with much blank surface. The rendering conventions differ sharply — dense, deeply undercut, ornament-saturated anthropomorphic composition versus flat, minimal, outline-only animal relief — so nothing suggests a shared iconographic scheme.
